rules.quote: Cite an authorised law report if one is available
rules.specification: When citing a legal case, use the citation for an authorised law report series if the judgment has been reported in one.

covers.quote: Use the correct abbreviations for Australian law report series.

rules.quote: Use common abbreviations for authorised reports
rules.specification: Use the standard abbreviation for the authorised law report series (e.g. CLR for Commonwealth Law Reports, NSWLR for New South Wales Law Reports post-1971).
rules.violation_condition: citing an authorised law report series using an abbreviation or full name other than the standard common abbreviation for that series and period
when: Citing an authorised Australian law report.

rules.quote: Use standard abbreviations for unauthorised reports
rules.specification: If no authorised version of a report exists, use the standard abbreviations from the recognised list for unauthorised law report series.
rules.violation_condition: citing an unauthorised law report series using an abbreviation or name other than the standard abbreviation when no authorised version is available
when: The law report has no authorised version.
